summary: Composites input 1 over input 2 using a selected channel from input 3 as the matte mask.

key_params.name: mattechannel
key_params.note: luminance, rgba channels, rgbaverage, average, rgbmax, or max

common_gotchas: Matte TOP expects three inputs; missing or constant input3 makes output look fully foreground or background.
Using the wrong matte channel can invert the perceived cutout or flatten transparency.
switchinputs changes compositing semantics, not only the visible order in the network editor.
The official token max means RGBA Maximum, while rgbmax means RGB Maximum.
key_concepts: Composites input1 over input2 using input3 as the matte image.
The matte channel menu selects luminance, color, alpha, average, or maximum as the matte source.
White matte values draw input1 while black matte values leave input2 visible.
switchinputs is equivalent to swapping input1 and input2 and inverting the input3 alpha role.
The operator supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.
